The original owner suffered terribly before returning to his wealthy family. Initially cautious and modest, he grew envious and jealous of his popular brother. He constantly fought against him, ultimately becoming an early-death cannon fodder.
Well-versed in the plot and the author’s style, Chu Shi decided to win over his heartthrob protagonist brother.
So he became his brother’s assistant, helped with his classes, acted as his body double, and became a touching and devoted brother.
Before long, he discovered that something was amiss—
The heartthrob clung to him, calling him ‘brother’ with an extreme brother complex: Brother is mine, don’t even think about fighting me over him!
The cold and ruthless, domineering CEO: You’re mine! I won’t allow it. I won’t permit it—it’s not possible!
The sinister teacher: Baby, free private tutoring, do you like it?
The aloof and abstinent top star: You’re my only confidant, I can’t lose you!
Chu parents: Our baby suffered, we must compensate our baby!
Wait, he only wanted to change his twin brother’s villainous ending, how did he become the heartthrob instead?

1. True domineering CEO gong VS scheming shou
2. This novel is 1v1, no harem
3. This novel is a slow-paced slice-of-life sweet story, with plot and romance unfolding bit by bit.
4. If you don’t like it, don’t force yourself. There are many good novels out there. Also, please don’t lecture about writing. Thanks.
5. Read civilized. If you don’t like it, just close it. If you personally attack me, I will curse back.

159213.synopsis:
Faking one’s death, is the gold standard for exiting a world at the Transmigration Bureau.
Shen Buqi is a specialist in this field with a top-tier performance record, though he does have one minor quirk. As the Head of the “Melodramatic Heartbreak Department,” he insists on dragging everyone through every classic, gut-wrenching trope imaginable before he finally makes his grand exit.
World ①: Parasite x Loss of Control x Deathbed Revelry [ABO] Everyone said Mu Chuan was the luckiest man alive. A low-grade Alpha and a literal nobody from an orphanage, he somehow ended up married to Pei Shu—an S-rank Omega, billionaire heir, and superstar pro-gamer.
Pei Shu treated him exceptionally well. He bought him crisp white shirts, cashmere scarves, and chokers; he personally trimmed the bangs that veiled Mu Chuan’s eyes and fitted him with heavy-rimmed glasses. Every night, Pei Shu would use a silk tie to bind their wrists together. After all, Mu Chuan was a dull, cowardly wretch who couldn’t step outside, sleep alone, or even survive without Pei Shu.
Even Mu Chuan believed that.
Lying in bed, Mu Chuan turned his face away, his trembling, paralyzed right hand shielding the faint glow of his phone. He had a few secrets: he had accidentally “cheated” with Pei Shu’s arch-rival, Pei Shu’s older brother, and Pei Shu’s biggest investor. But those secrets along with the cancer cells currently colonizing his body, would surely follow him peacefully into the grave.
World ②: Betrayal x Farewell x Seven Days Later [Modern Wealthy Society] Jin Xuezhi was cold to the marrow. He was a ruthless man who disregarded family and used everyone even those closest to him as mere pawns. He had carved away his conscience and his humanity to claw his way to the top.
It took ten years, but he finally reached the pinnacle of power and exacted his revenge, settling every old debt. Then, he died.
His soul lingered for seven days. And the person who “picked up” his ghost? None other than the powerful ex-husband he had once used, betrayed, and discarded.
World ③: Cold War x Breakup x Never Meeting Again [Modern Urban] The first twelve years of He Mingchan’s life were pure bliss—filled with parents, a grandmother, Uncle Si, popsicles, and sweet summer dreams. Then, in the twelfth year, the floods came.
He was left with only Si Baiqian.
Si Baiqian was the first postgraduate student to emerge from their small village a golden boy and a financial elite. As the gap between them widened, a breakup seemed like the only logical conclusion. So, He Mingchan became a “Platinum” delivery rider, working tirelessly to save starving college students.
The only minor hiccup: on the day they broke up, He Mingchan suffered heatstroke while out on a delivery and crashed his bike straight into a Bentley.
World ④: Overconfident x Fearless x Doomed [Ancient China] As an Emperor, Shen Ciqing had killed many people in his lifetime.
Among them was the person he once promised to spend his life with. Now, that person has returned as a vengeful spirit, seeking his life. Shen Ciqing happily bared his neck to the blade, welcoming the end.
But the ghost hesitated; it couldn’t bring itself to let him go.

With a spoiled Mother who held no real power and a beautiful but witless Sister who could not be relied upon, Xie Yuwei had no choice but to cling to the hand that moved the chess pieces and conspire with the tiger.
If her Sister was too consumed by love to be of use, then she would take her place. If Xie Zhouyu wanted to overthrow the Jin Dynasty, then she would become the Crown Princess of Jin, bear Xie Zhouyu’s Son, poison the Crown Prince, and install the child on the supreme throne.
